lines.en: My roots creep forward an inch at a time.
Soil falls from between my leaves.
I drag my tuber along.
Mandrake roots serve as my legs.
My crown of leaves sways as I advance.
I push the soil aside step by step.
Root tips feel along the ground.
I move as slowly as a plant grows.
My leaves rustle with every step.
Even buried, I can still walk.
The cyan flower moves along with me.
I shuffle toward the loose earth.
I pretend to be ordinary grass.
My roots stretch quietly underground.
Leaf tips still, I wait.
I am soaking up the sun.
Step on my leaves and I will scream.
I bury my face in the dirt.
Poison mist curls around me.
Poison does nothing to me.
A breeze makes me sway.
I am counting the bugs passing by.
The flower blooms, and I wake.
Do not step there, I am playing dead.
The soil is warm, just right.
My leaves keep watch for me.
I am sharpening my root tips.
Whoever digs me up will regret it.
I hear a shovel somewhere.
Keep that fire away from me.
Did you just touch my flower?
Crouch down, let me look at you.
You are not holding a shovel, are you?
I am staring at your boots.
You are blocking my sunlight.
Your footsteps are too loud.
I know the soil on your clothes.
Are you here to dig me up?
I look up at you from the soil.
Stay away from my roots.
You are deciding whether to strike.
I smile like a rotting log.
You hurt my root!
I tremble with pain.
One of my leaves came off.
I will remember that blade.
My roots pull back.
My scream grows louder.
Sap runs into the soil.
So you really did strike.
Poison cannot hurt me, but pain can.
One more and I break.
I cannot resist the smell of damp soil.
The ground over there is wet.
I creep toward the moisture.
Sun and wet earth, I want both.
You have wetted the ground.
My roots are itching for it.
That dampness is calling me.
I smell rain.
Do not shake the dirt off, leave it.
I want to root myself there.
You stepped on my leaves.
Try bumping into me, then.
My root is hard as stone.
Do not shove, I cannot move aside.
Your kick made me wobble.
I drive my roots deeper.
A bump will not push me back.
My tuber jabs into you.
You crushed one of my leaves.
Move over, I walk slowly.
The wind will carry my pollen.
Looking for a flower of my kind.
My seeds need to reach soil.
Do not interrupt us now.
Our roots twine together.
The cyan flower will bear another me.
New sprouts will rise from the soil.
The flowering season will not wait.
I give off a sweet scent.
I tuck my seeds under the earth.
I curl a root around this thing.
Dropped things belong to me.
I tuck the iron nugget into the soil.
This little stone will do.
My root tips are nimble.
Hidden where no one will find it.
I wedge it beside my tuber.
You find all sorts of things in soil.
You dropped it, I picked it up.
One hook of a root and it is mine.
You dared to touch that flower.
Now it is my turn.
My roots have found you.
Do not run, I chase slowly.
I am angry now.
All my leaves are standing up.
I will remember you.
Can you afford that blow?
I see you behind that tree.

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在我的土上
lines.en: Your prints are on my soil.
I creep a little closer.
The grass will not hide you.
My roots are waiting below.
I count your heartbeat.
You are still holding that blade.
I fix my eyes on your ankles.
My vine whips down.
Take a jab from my root.
I spit poison at you.
My leaves slice your skin.
Roots wrap around your legs.
This blow carries poison.
I lash out with a whole vine.
Losing your footing yet?
My scream rattles your ears.
And here comes another.
Someone touched the cyan flower.
The flower is gone, I have come.
A crack opens in the earth.
I am awake.
Who pulled up my flower?
My roots come out first.
I have waited long under this soil.
My leaves unfold one by one.
A scream is my greeting.
The smell of earth follows me.
Fire! Keep that flame away from me.
My tuber cracked on landing.
Water is rotting my roots.
The blast tore the soil apart.
Who shot that at me?
That strange magic seeps into my veins.
There is no nourishment left in the soil.
Lightning burned through my leaves.
Soil and root, all falling away.
